spans.s: झि (1) verb-ending of the 3rd pers. pl. Parasmaipada, substituted for the लकार of the ten lakaras, chang- ed to जुस in the potential and the benedictive moods, and optionally so in the imperfect and after the sign स् of the aorist; cf.P,
: (2) a conventional term for अव्यय (in- declinable) used in the Jainendra Vyakaraha.
